integrity: The proof is analytic. A numerical checker independently verifies the unitary covariance and both directional-discord identities on finite random samples; those tests are supportive rather than substituting for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the two-qubit XXZ Gibbs family with \(T>0\) and the one-sided Hilbert--Schmidt geometric discord used in the source. It does not claim an explicit new GQD formula or extend automatically to metrics lacking the required covariance.
title: Field reversal exchanges the measured side of geometric discord in an inhomogeneous XXZ dimer
